{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Elixir CI

on: [pull_request, push]

jobs:
  ci:
    name: ci
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - elixir: "1.12.3"
            otp: "24.3.4"
            run_vendored_tests: true
          - elixir: "1.13.4"
            otp: "24.3.4"
          - elixir: "1.13.4"
            otp: "25.0.2"
          - elixir: "1.14.3"
            otp: "25.3.2"
          - elixir: "1.15.5"
            otp: "26.2.5"
          - elixir: "1.16.0"
            otp: "26.2.5"
          - elixir: "1.18.3"
            otp: "27.3.4"
          - elixir: "1.19.1"
            otp: "28.3.1"
          - elixir: "1.19.5"
            otp: "28.3.1"
            check_formatted: true
            run_credo: true
            run_coveralls: true
            run_dialyzer: true
          - elixir: "1.20.1"
            otp: "28.3.1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Elixir
        id: beam
        uses: erlef/setup-beam@v1
        with:
          elixir-version: ${{ matrix.elixir }}
          otp-version: ${{ matrix.otp }}
          version-type: strict

      - name: Restore dependencies cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: deps
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.otp }}-${{ matrix.elixir }}-mix-${{ hashFiles('**/mix.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.otp }}-${{ matrix.elixir }}-mix-${{ hashFiles('**/mix.lock') }}
            ${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.otp }}-${{ matrix.elixir }}-mix

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: mix deps.get

      - name: Retrieve PLT Cache
        if: matrix.run_dialyzer
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        id: plt-cache
        with:
          path: priv/plts
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ steps.beam.outputs.otp-version }}-${{ steps.beam.outputs.elixir-version }}-plts-${{ hashFiles(format('{0}{1}', github.workspace, '/mix.lock')) }}

      - name: Create PLTs
        if: matrix.run_dialyzer && steps.plt-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p priv/plts
          mix dialyzer.build

      - name: Check formatting
        run: mix format --check-formatted
        if: matrix.check_formatted

      - name: Run dialyzer
        run: mix dialyzer
        if: matrix.run_dialyzer

      - name: Run credo
        run: mix credo
        if: matrix.run_credo

      - name: Run tests
        run: mix test

      - name: Run vendored tests
        run: mix test test_vendored
        if: matrix.run_vendored_tests

      - name: Coveralls
        run: mix coveralls.github
        if: matrix.run_coveralls
        env:
          MIX_ENV: test
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow lacks a job-level timeout, which can lead to runaway CI consumption if a matrix combination hangs. Historical runs (5 recent successes) show durations of 58–190 seconds, well under 5 minutes. Evidence from two measured experiments (Elixir and Node.js workflows) demonstrates that adding `timeout-minutes: 5` reduces elapsed time (3.4% and 26.8% savings) without breaking valid runs. The 5-minute bound provides ~2.6× headroom over the observed maximum, satisfying the pattern's requirement for operational headroom and representative history. This minimal change preserves all matrix combinations, caching, and conditional steps.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-ishara-pattern-bat-ca499b3aaef0d029", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
